context.scope: Real FUSE mount; one deterministic standard-library analysis; environment summary is not an environment archive.

cases.name: public Iris case records exact inputs, excluded unused files, output digests and a lightweight environment summary
cases.detail: 4 exact inputs; unused Bezdek/names/Index excluded; 3 output digests; environment summary present; verify re-hashes outputs

cases.name: comparison ignores experiment name, PID, timestamps and read counters
cases.detail: renamed experiment, new PID/timestamps/read counters produce zero content changes and are listed as run metadata

cases.name: same-name data and config changes alter results and appear as content changes
cases.detail: same-name iris.data edit changes a reported mean; same-name config edit changes rounding and output; comparison names both changed inputs

cases.name: failed program keeps verifiable failure evidence and compares output add/remove
cases.detail: program exit 2 still records failure.json, exit status and environment; comparison reports added failure.json and removed result.json

cases.name: old-input replay is byte-identical and compares without content change
cases.detail: replay from the baseline snapshot reproduces result/stdout/stderr byte-for-byte and SHA256; comparison shows no content change

cases.name: verify rejects tampered output content and unsafe report paths
cases.detail: verify rejects a changed output digest and an output path escaping the report directory
